subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a BOOT.md larger than 16 MiB be reported as a failed boot check or silently skipped as empty?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded memory use, but only failure tells operators that configured startup instructions did not run; no current documented contract selects the tradeoff.

options.title: Fail visibly on overflow
options.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators can correct the file while preserving startup-task observability.

options.title: Skip oversized files
options.body: Treat overflow as empty and continue gateway startup without executing the file, accepting that the omission is only visible in debug-level behavior.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly on overflow
recommendation.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators can correct the file while preserving startup-task observability.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current loader implementation and is the strongest recent owner signal for this startup behavior contract.
